summary: Installing GMDSS equipment, the annual ship station inspection, and the test instruments a maintainer sets up and reads.

blocks.title: Installing the equipment
items: Inmarsat-C antenna: 8 meters minimum from other Inmarsat antennas. A close one overloads the equipment.
Terminal ground: copper strap brazed to the steel terminal and steel hull. RF runs on a conductor's surface, so wide and flat wins. Brazing can't work loose.
Once installed: enter your Inmarsat Mobile Number in the terminal.
Full-duplex VHF: maximum separation between transmitting antenna and duplex receiver antenna, or the strong signal desensitizes the receiver.
Depth transducer: an area not subject to cavitation. Bubbles absorb and scatter the pulse.

blocks.title: The annual inspection (survey)
items: Who: a GMDSS Maintainer's License holder. An operator's license won't do.
Battery: off charge, at maximum required load. Measure and record maximum discharge current and voltage.
VHF: power output and VSWR on channels 6, 13 and 16, frequency tolerance, all required power sources. Not carrier deviation.
Inmarsat-C: send a brief test message to your own terminal.
Log: certified by both the inspecting technician and the vessel's Master or owner.
Issued: Cargo Ship Safety Certificate.

items.name: Digital meter error: 5 V on the 6 V scale
items.means: A count is a last-digit step: 0.001 V here.

items.name: 24 V on the 60 V scale
items.means: The exam's answer, though it doesn't fit the formula.

items.name: 10:1 scope probe
items.means: A load of about 10 MΩ shunted by 12 pF. 1/10 of the signal reaches the scope.

items.name: SINAD: signal plus noise and distortion
items.means: In decibels. 12 dB SINAD is the usual sensitivity reference.

blocks.title: Other instruments
items: Signal generator: low signal leakage is its most important spec.
Dual-trace scope: the Mode control selects either channel alone or a combination of both.
Function generator: sine, square and triangular waves.
Logic probe: red high, green low, amber pulse.
Deviation meter: measures the carrier deviation in an FM transmitter. Marine VHF limit: ±5 kHz.
Spectrum analyzer: strength against frequency, to measure spurious signals.

blocks.title: Exam traps
items: Never test with a distress alert.
Not the best ground: No. 10 wire, bolted aluminum strap.
Battery test isn't specific gravity or a 6 hour discharge.
The survey never issues a Radio Station License or FCC 817.
Red and green LEDs on together don't mean a short.
SINAD uses a bandstop filter, not bandpass.
A deviation meter doesn't read sidebands or modulation index.
